properties.description: Pins the merge-survivor rule on in-memory designs, editing the proposal as JSON the way an MCP client sends it back: a swapped keep/remove and a chosen_survivor each keep the person's pick, and a pick outside the pair is refused before any write; a merge carries both candidates ranked with their reasons and recommends only on a real difference; a pair tied on everything says "no recommendation: a person must pick" and is refused without chosen_survivor, also when keep/remove are swapped or the survivor block is stripped; the id never decides in either sort order; would_destroy no longer blames the alphabet; a withdrawn node never outlives a live one; and the two recorded cases recommend who:ajs (connections) and the critical requirement (priority).
properties.name: tests/the_engine_proposes_a_merge_and_a_person_picks_the_survivor.rs
